title: Word Formation: Od przymiotnika do rzeczownika (krok 1: koncowki)

tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij kazde zdanie jednym wyrazem, przeksztalcajac wyraz podany wielkimi literami obok luki. Wymagana jest calkowita poprawnosc ortograficzna. W tym cwiczeniu wystarczy dodac koncowke - zaden wyraz nie potrzebuje przedrostka.

items.sentence: The campaign raised public __________ of the problem.
Gymnasts need enormous __________ in every joint.
Art lessons are there to develop children's __________.
He lifted the box easily - he has surprising __________.
The __________ of plants in the rainforest is astonishing.
Nobody understood the __________ of the discovery at the time.
Dolphins are known for their __________ and their memory.
She has the __________ to become a professional musician.
